MPPSC Assistant Town Planner Admit Card 2026 - Complete Details

MPPSC Assistant Town Planner Admit Card 2026. Candidates can now download their admit card / hall ticket from the official website before the exam date. The last date to apply is 19/03/2026. Check important dates, application fee, eligibility criteria and official links below.

Important Dates

  • Start Date : 20/02/2026
  • Last Date : 19/03/2026
  • Last Date Pay Fees : 19/03/2026
  • Form Correction Last Date : 21/03/2026
  • With Late Fees Phase I Last Date : 26/03/2026
  • With Late Fees Phase II Last Date : 26/08/2026
  • Admit Card Released Date : 10/09/2026
  • Exam Date : 20/09/2026
  • Result Declared Date : As Per Schedule
  • Download Admit Card : Click Here

Application Fee

  • Start Date : 20/02/2026
  • Last Date : 19/03/2026
  • Last Date Pay Fees : 19/03/2026
  • Form Correction Last Date : 21/03/2026
  • With Late Fees Phase I Last Date : 26/03/2026
  • With Late Fees Phase II Last Date : 26/08/2026
  • General / Other State : Rs. 540/-
  • OBC / EWS / SC / ST : Rs. 290/-
  • Post Name : Total Post
  • Assistant Town Planner : 39

How to Download Admit Card

  1. Visit the official website.
  2. Click on the admit card / hall ticket link.
  3. Enter your registration number / roll number and date of birth / password.
  4. Click on submit to view your admit card.
  5. Download and take a printout. Carry it to the exam center along with a photo ID.
